title: Hostage Thanks Vizhnitzer Rebbe
body: Yosef Chaim Ochana, freed from Hamas captivity, thanks Vizhnitzer Rebbe at Chanukah candle lighting in Bnei Brak, Israel.

title: Mavis Tire Shabbos Settlement
body: A Jewish job applicant was rejected due to Shabbos observance, prompting a federal investigation. Mavis Tire agreed to pay $304,000 to resolve the case brought by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission.

title: Kiryat Melech Chanukah Panel
body: Rav Shlomo Kanievsky addressed talmidim concerns at Yeshivas Kiryat Melech's Chanukah mesibah, discussing draft worries, Shabbos in yeshiva, and chinuch for the future.

title: Yenuka Leads Chanukah Event
body: Thousands flocked to an Ashkelon venue for a massive Chanukah gathering led by Rav Shlomo Yehuda Be'eri, prompting organizers to close gates and set up an outdoor screen for the overflow crowd.
